Class MoleculeBatch

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculeBatch
public final class MoleculeBatch extends Object
Collects several registration changes so they can be applied together.

A batch changes only one owner's definitions. Removing that owner's entry can reveal a definition supplied by another source, rather than removing the molecule everywhere.
